bibl.title: P.Ryl. inv. 1106: Testo magico e esercizio calligrafico?
bibl.seg: Lorenzo Sardone, P. Ryl. inv. 1106: Testo magico o esercizio calligrafico?
bibl.note: P. Ryl. inv. 1106 is a small papyrus fragment, written by an evolving hand in Biblical Majuscule. Its text could be interpreted as a magical formula or as a writing exercise, that reports part of AP IX 538. 2nd half of the IVth cent.
